Negotiate a Treaty Port at Sanmen
Our envoys propose an Italian commercial enclave at Sanmen. The Chinese government must agree to the cession. A refusal or an unanswered proposal returns the reserved funds to the treasury.
Italy seeks a coastal enclave at Sanmen. Its envoys offer compensation and commercial relations in exchange for sovereignty over the port. Acceptance transfers the district to Italian administration.
The Chinese government has accepted our proposal. The port passes to Italian administration under the new treaty.
The proposed cession could not be concluded. The reserved funds have returned to the treasury.
The ministry has closed this diplomatic file. Any funds still reserved for an unanswered offer return to the treasury.
